XP/EXP

Common abbreviations for experience points, a game resource used to measure progress and often advance a character’s level or abilities.

  • Games
  • Vocabulary

Context

Games can award experience for battles, quests, exploration, or other accomplishments. The amount needed for a new level and the benefits of gaining one depend on the game.

In Pokémon, experience contributes to a Pokémon’s progress toward higher levels. Individual games can also give familiar abbreviations special meanings within their stories.

Examples

  • A character gains enough XP from a completed quest to reach the next level.
